implementation_preflight_history: the first calibration invocation stopped before artifact output because pairwise coverage expanded a sample-by-candidate-by-candidate-by-action tensor; the exact distance calculation was changed to 32-sample batches without changing candidates, metrics, thresholds, or decisions
scope: offline design and frozen development evaluation of one deterministic one-shot candidate interface using expert-action MSE only; no future model, value, reranker, simulator, or controller
sample_contract: only explicitly admitted task/demo HDF5 groups; natural observation and proprio at k feed frozen C0-v2 and expert target is actions[k+1:k+9]

primary_metric.name: raw expert-action MSE
primary_metric.oracle: minimum-MSE candidate with stable lowest-index tie break
primary_metric.interpretation: offline imitation headroom only; unavailable at deployment and not reward, task value, or success

candidate_design.seed_rule: partition-row order plus direction_index*1000003; antithetic signs interleave + then -; no task-specific seed or rule

gripper_contract.standalone_G2: G1 plus both switch directions after steps 1,2,4,6,7; constant endpoints replace duplicate boundary switches

candidate_design.allocation_meaning: N_total is frozen by the count screen; each allocation contains A0, N_total-1-G continuous proposals, then G structured gripper proposals; no Cartesian product

validity.scale_2p5_stop_rule: remove 2.5x before selection if any fixed validity limit fails

selection_rules.scale_selection: among valid N32 antithetic scales with H8 gain >=5%, maximize mean H1/H2 gain; if within 1pp choose lower scale
selection_rules.bank_style_selection: if antithetic and independent differ by <1pp on both H8 and mean H1/H2, choose antithetic; otherwise maximize mean H1/H2 then H8
selection_rules.count_selection: choose smallest of N16/N24/N32 with H8>=5%, >=90% of N64 H8 gain, all ten tasks positive, and validity; otherwise choose N64 only if N64 materially exceeds N32 by the frozen doubling rule, else choose N32
selection_rules.gripper_inclusion: structured allocation must improve H8 over matched continuous-only by >=5pp with paired CI lower >0, or improve mean H1/H2 by >=10pp with each positive
selection_rules.allocation_selection: among passing G4/G8/G12 choose highest calibration H8 gain; if within 1pp choose fewer gripper candidates; if none pass choose G0
selection_rules.authorization: selected interface must be valid, H8>=5% with CI lower >0, positive on >=7 tasks, H1>=10%, uniquely calibration-selected, and on the evaluation H1/H8/count Pareto frontier

statistics.unit: task-stratified demo/init block; resample four complete demos per task and retain every legal action window

forbidden: run simulator or produce real future RGB/state
read reward, done, success, or final task outcome
use Gaussian gripper proposals in the selected production interface
retune or run CEM, MPPI, beam search, or any iterative planner
train or modify a World Model, encoder, actor, proposal policy, reranker, goal, value, cost, score, or controller
claim expert-action MSE is a deployable value function
authorize a spatial World Model or controller
